title: RoboBeats: Pumpkin Catch
duplicate_check: No matching host in prior-urls.json, catalog-baseline.json published_games, or previously_seen_urls.
controls_actions: Selected Level 1: London Night, the pumpkin catcher, and Slow speed.
Clicked Play to enter the live round.
Moved the pointer to the right side of the playfield; the pumpkin catcher shifted from center to the right and the caught-treat progress increased to two.
gameplay_outcome: A falling-candy round visibly ran. Pointer input moved the catcher, and the progress row showed two caught treats. The site description says to move left/right to catch treats.
mechanics: Catch falling Halloween treats by moving a selected catcher left and right. The setup offers three unlockable themed levels, four catcher characters, and slow/fast speed.
visual_art: Original painterly Halloween London street at night, full moon and rooftops, jack-o-lantern catcher holding a basket, candy sprites, plus small robot characters in the setup art.
existing_custom_cover_evidence: The title/setup screen uses bespoke Pumpkin Catch lettering and game-specific London, robot, and Halloween art; no separate cover asset was verified.
thumbnail_concepts: Text-free close-up of the jack-o-lantern catcher as colorful candy rains over a moonlit London street.
The pumpkin catcher dashing toward a large cluster of falling sweets, with the London skyline and full moon framing the action.
screenshot_note: Gameplay screenshots were captured and shown inline in the CUA tool output; this subagent CUA surface exposes no supported local screenshot-file export, so no path was saved.
audio: The page Sound toggle was clicked and its accessibility state changed to Sound off (Value 1) before starting. This is not proof of browser-level muting. All test tabs were closed immediately when parent reported the user still heard audio; no further testing.
